segments.name: Signal Integrity
segments.description: Designs and sells optical and copper data communications and video transport semiconductors for infrastructure and industrial applications.
segments.evidence: We design, develop, manufacture and market a portfolio of optical and copper data communications and video transport products used in a wide variety of infrastructure and industrial applications.

segments.name: Analog Mixed Signal and Wireless
products: LoRa® devices and wireless radio frequency technology
segments.description: Designs and sells protection, sensing, wireless radio frequency (including LoRa) and power management semiconductors for consumer, industrial and automotive applications.
segments.evidence: We design, develop, manufacture and market high-performance protection devices, which are often referred to as transient voltage suppressors ("TVS") and specialized sensing products.

segments.name: IoT Systems and Connectivity
segments.description: Designs and markets IoT modules, gateways, routers and connected services enabling businesses to connect, manage and operate IoT devices.
segments.evidence: The portfolio includes a wide range of modules, gateways, routers, and connected services that are designed to meet the specific needs of different industries and applications.

revenueModel.text: Semtech earns revenue primarily from selling semiconductor and IoT products to OEMs, IoT device makers, enterprises and solution providers, largely through independent distributors, on individual customer purchase orders.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive our revenue primarily from the sale of our products into various end markets.

changes.text: In 2026, Semtech acquired HieFo Corporation and began operating foundries, adopting a fab-lite manufacturing model.
changes.evidence: On March 3, 2026, we completed the acquisition of HieFo Corporation in an all-cash transaction representing a total purchase consideration of approximately $34.0 million (the "HieFo Acquisition").
